title: The Grunion Run, 2017 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day before the twentieth run: Gully with the lanterns on the counter, nine, and a lockbox key-safe he's pulled off a rental's doorframe by mistake — no, on purpose — sitting beside them. He puts it back before dark. Wood watched him take it.

panels.composition: The shack. Nine lanterns on the counter. Beside them, a small gray key-safe, unscrewed. GULLY. WOOD on the stool. The PUP.
